system.description:
The mounted knight: the Knights of Holfast, steeped in mounted war and formal doctrine, and the Eltor Cavalry Guard, the lance-and-horse elite of the Eltor court.

  • Saddle-Born (1st): while you are mounted, your Challenge reaches 60ft and a foe need only see you, not hear you. Your mount has Advantage on saves against fear and against effects that would unseat you.
  • The Order's Name (1st): Advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks when invoking your order's name, and on checks to judge a horse's quality.
  • Lancer's Charge (5th): a mounted charge triples the lance's damage dice instead of doubling them (flat modifiers are not multiplied).
  • Mounted Champion (10th): once per encounter, your first hit while mounted on your Challenged foe doubles the weapon's damage dice. From 17th, Honour Attack triples them instead of doubling them.
